title: The Barn | R&SVP – Hio Ridge, Bridgton, Maine
description: Explore our barn wedding venue in Bridgton, Maine. Original 1820 beams, rooms for getting ready and a field facing Pleasant Mountain. Up to 135 guests.
heading: Take your seat *beneath the 1820 beams.*
lede: From the head table, look out through the French doors toward the field. Above the main floor, the loft has more dining space among the old timbers. Explore the rooms below, then talk with Susan about an arrangement for your guests.
hero_alt: Looking down the barn toward the French doors, a chandelier overhead and the loft rail on both sides

spaces.title: Dinner on the main floor
spaces.body: Our French doors open from the main floor onto the patio. Choose long tables or rounds for dinner beneath the beams. We include tables and chairs with rental.
spaces.alt: The main floor of the barn, timber posts and beams, chandeliers, loft rail above

spaces.title: A table in the loft
spaces.body: Our loft offers dining space among the old timbers, overlooking the main floor. Ask Susan about seating and access before deciding who sits upstairs.
spaces.alt: The loft of the barn, roof structure and reclaimed windows, a doorway at the end

spaces.title: Getting ready in the bridal room
spaces.body: Your dress has its own hook beside the vanity and arched mirror. The bridal room is in the ell, the building beside the barn, with space to get ready with your wedding party.
spaces.alt: The bridal room with sheer curtains, a vanity and an arched mirror

spaces.title: A room for the groom's party
spaces.body: Take a moment with your wedding party before the ceremony. We have a separate groom's room in the ell, with a mirror and benches.
spaces.alt: The groom's room, white walls, exposed beams, a wood bench and a window

spaces.title: A kitchen for your caterer
spaces.body: Share the meal you've chosen with your guests. Our prep kitchen gives your outside caterer a place for the finishing touches, with barn doors they can close while they work. [CONFIRM: any caterer requirements]
spaces.alt: The prep kitchen: white cabinets, stainless appliances, barn doors on the open side

spaces.title: Conversations on the patio
spaces.body: Step outside to catch up with someone you haven't seen in a while. Our patio has evening string lights and a paved path around the barn. Nearby, the stone planters and seating circle use rocks from beneath the old barn.
spaces.alt: The patio, a stone planter and the boulder seating circle, birches behind

spaces.title: Vows facing Pleasant Mountain
spaces.body: See your guests waiting on the benches as you approach. Our ceremony field faces Pleasant Mountain. We made the benches from old barn floorboards. [CONFIRM: arbor built]
spaces.alt: Benches in the field, birches at the edge, the barn in the distance

facts.label: Capacity
facts.value: Up to 135 guests per event. Ask about seating for your layout

facts.label: Included
facts.value: Tables and chairs, with long and round table options

facts.label: Parking
facts.value: A lot for 66 cars, plus three accessible spaces in the driveway

facts.label: Accessibility
facts.value: A wooden ramp to the main floor, an ADA accessible bathroom, and a paved path around the barn to the patio

facts.label: Alcohol
facts.value: No alcohol, cannabis or smoking at events

facts.label: Catering
facts.value: Outside caterers, with a prep kitchen on site

facts.label: Restrooms
facts.value: [CONFIRM: indoor restrooms and rentals for large events]

closing.heading: See the rooms, then plan the seating.
closing.body: See how the spaces connect and talk through where your guests would sit. Contact Susan to schedule a tour.

seating.heading: Plan where everyone will sit.
seating.intro: These arrangements show different ways to use the barn and patio. Our total event capacity is 135. Ask Susan which combination of spaces works for your guest count, including an indoor plan for wet weather.

layouts.label: Ceremony
layouts.alt: Ceremony rows on the main floor facing the French doors
layouts.body: We've arranged ceremony rows on the main floor facing the French doors. Ask Susan how this setup would work with your reception.

layouts.label: Round tables
layouts.alt: Round tables on the main floor
layouts.body: This downstairs arrangement seats 44 to 46, using five round tables and one rectangle. Ask Susan about the full dining layout for your group.

layouts.label: Long tables
layouts.alt: The head table set at the open French doors
layouts.body: Seat your guests along tables measuring 6 or 8 feet long. The head table shown here sits at the French doors.

layouts.label: The patio
layouts.alt: Round tables on the patio beside the barn
layouts.body: This patio arrangement seats 72 at nine tables. Discuss an indoor alternative with Susan before planning dinner outside.
